<!-- pr-reviewer: 016d417de78ed50995c10047bdc069abf8c83f6f -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (a `feat`, so at the next cut).

Thanks @vilts - nice follow-up to #678.

**What looks good**
- Trial merge with current main is clean; #678 is already in main, so the diff is just the one commit (19 files).
- No new `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` in non-test code; the spot is passed through the existing `in_world` frame map, and `to_raw_mouths` now quotes the world mouth like every other cross-hole refusal.
- Pinning tests assert the spot on the existing refusal tests; unlocated sites carry a one-line reason.
- No build.rs, scripts, `.github`, dependency or `CHANGELOG.md` changes. Provenance, decision record (`docs/decisions/677-refusal-spots.md`), `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #677` are present.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main, macOS)**
| check | result |
|---|---|
| camcraft-motion lib | 163 passed |
| motion tests face_holes / ruling | 7 / 10 passed |
| app drill_reach / drill_reach_fit / drill_rplane | 6 / 3 / 8 passed |
| app drilling_axial / refusal_location / stitch_cross | 7 / 3 / 6 passed |
| clippy -D warnings: motion + app lib, motion tests, the five touched app test targets | clean |

Not run: the whole app test build, which fails on main in `crates/app/tests/lathe_thread_travel.rs` (missing `hand` field, tracked as #686, not this PR). UI crate not built; this commit's UI files were already in via #678.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `crates/motion/src/drilling/cross.rs` is now 401 lines (the ~400 guide); fine, but the next change there should split it.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
